description: Indonesian Disaster Data and Information (DIBI) is a data repository run by National Disaster Management Agency (BNPB), Indonesia. DIBI is the national database of disaster events with dates, locations, casualties, damaged houses and facilities such as schools, health and worship buildings, compiled from regional disaster agencies from the 1800s to the present. Coverage: Indonesia (by province and district). It is reached online through the home page and its search, download or service pages, in forms such as html, xlsx; access is free of charge and open to view; downloads may need a free account. The licence is: terms set by the site, not read in this search. Caveats: the home page was opened on 2026-09-30 and only its title ("Tentang DIBI") was read, so the holdings, the current terms and the availability of downloads were not browsed, and this description rests on the agency's publicly documented role and may lag the site. It can support hazard loss statistics and exposure studies of Indonesian infrastructure. Related records: no directly related record is catalogued yet.
